limits: Peak W4A4 speedup is not an iso-accuracy claim

rounding_analysis.assumption: Latencies and speedups are independently rounded to nearest 0.01; this is an analytical assumption, not a verified author rounding policy.
rounding_analysis.method: For displayed baseline a and latency b, bound the underlying ratio by (a-0.005)/(b+0.005) and (a+0.005)/(b-0.005). Compare with reported speedup plus/minus 0.005. Closed intervals conservatively include rounding ties.

rounding_compatible_mismatch.interpretation: Underlying unrounded latencies could reconcile this cell; do not classify it with the two robust inconsistencies.

pdf_verification.limit: Arithmetic consistency is not experimental reproduction. Two ratios remain inconsistent under the stated rounding assumption and appear exchanged, but raw runs are needed to identify which source values are wrong. A third strict displayed-value difference is rounding-compatible, not a proven error.

files.finding: First-column scores are averaged over batch, summed over heads, and ranked before masking/softmax; selected indices are shared across the batch.
Quantized/rescaled weights feed torch F.linear; this inspected QAT path is not a demonstrated packed-integer mobile kernel.
Recipe names W4/A8/A4 with a 0.5 low-bit ratio, batch 32 and sequence 128; checkpoint/data locations are placeholders.

unresolved: Mobile deployment kernel, measurement harness and raw Table IV timings not located in this revision; absence in this inspection is not proof no such artifact exists elsewhere.
Reconcile pre-softmax/batch-shared selection with intended attention-score semantics and released checkpoint provenance.
Training warmup steps are not evidence of device benchmark warmup.

next_action: Seek version-matched deployment harness/raw timings and reconcile token-selector semantics against checkpoint provenance; keep numerical claims and independent verdict pending.
